 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Lazio head coach Gennaro Gattuso should be able to count on Kenneth Taylor as a starter in Saturday's game against Parma.
 Lazio Looking to Extend Their Purple Patch Against Parma
 The high-flying Aquile have yet to taste a league defeat this season. They won six of their seven Serie A games thus far, dismantling Juventus by three unanswered goals in their most recent act. However, Gattuso warned his men against complacency when they host Parma at home on Saturday (20:45 local time).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Kenneth Taylor Should Be Fit for Lazio vs Parma
 According to La Lazio Siamo Noi , the head coach should keep his starting lineup intact, especially with Taylor overcoming the slight knock he suffered in Turin on Sunday. The Dutchman should thus take his place in the midfield trio alongside Davide Frattesi and Reda Belahyane, while Danilo Cataldi and Fisayo Dele-Bashiru start the contest on the bench.
 Lazio Lineup Remains Intact
 In the backline, Romano Floriani Mussolini and Nuno Tavares should flank Josip Sutalo and Oliver Provstgaard, with the in-form Christos Mandas starting behind them in goal. Despite Matteo Cancellieri's return from injury, Gustav Isaksen will keep his place on the right wing. Club captain Mattia Zaccagni will start on the opposite side, with Tijjani Noslin leading the line.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Tijjani Noslin the Favourite Over Andrea Pinamonti
 Sky Sport Italia and La Gazzetta dello Sport are reporting the same expected Lazio lineup, although the pink newspaper leaves a 30% chance for Andrea Pinamonti to replace Noslin upfront after contributing with a goal and an assist in his last two cameos against Monza and Juventus.
 Lazio vs Parma | Where to Watch, Insights, Lineups & Prediction
 Nevertheless, the Italian striker will most likely be kept on the bench, and perhaps challenge for a starting role against his former club, Sassuolo, in Tuesday's Serie A action
 Lazio Probable XI (4-3-3): Mandas; Floriani Mussolini, Sutalo, Provstgaard, Tavares; Frattesi, Belahyane, Taylor; Isaksen, Noslin, Zaccagni
